dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a continuous concave curvature from the apex to the dorsal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex leading edge oriented at an approximate 55-degree angle relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.4:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gently sloping convex arc with a large radius fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak morphology with a pixel length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced contrast between a dark dorsal field and a highly reflective white lateral/ventral field, with a visible dark ocular patch.
